text.tspan: PATH A: Payment gateway & VCC issuance completely bypassed

g.text: [Outcome B: Definitive Failure (e.g. inventory sold out / rejected)]

svg.text: Proactive WhatsApp Alert ([RESCUE MY TRIP] / [ABANDON RESCUE])
Dispatch Confirmation: Rescue closed. Original booking preserved.
"You have chosen not to proceed with Flyo Rescue. Original booking preserved."
"Your rescue request has been received. Retrieving itinerary & searching alternatives..."
Step 3: Fetch full PNR, onward international segments, hotel risks
Original booking segments & downstream connection profile
Step 4: Search candidate alternatives on carrier network
Live flight schedules, seat inventory, and published fare rules
Calculate published MCT + Flyo buffer and execute deterministic ranking
"No viable flights found within connection safety buffer. Handing over to human travel desk."
Step 5: Dispatches ranked flight options with interactive buttons
Displays options (Option 1: FL101 ₹0 | Option 2: FL301 +₹4,200 | Option 3: FL401 +₹1,500)
Step 6: Selects Option (e.g. SELECT_OPTION_O1 or SELECT_OPTION_O2)
Revalidate live carrier inventory and fare rules
Display updated fare & require fresh passenger consent
Step 7: Arms single-use OTP challenge (bound to Case, Phone, Option, Fare, Currency)
6-digit confirmation code generated (SHA-256 hash stored, 10m expiry)
Dispatches Itinerary Preview & Confirmation OTP prompt
"Review alternative flight. Reply with verification code to authorize rebooking"
Validate constant-time hash, expiry, attempt counter, binding
"Incorrect verification code. Please retry (X attempts remaining)."
"Verification code expired. New code generated. Please retry."
"Too many failed attempts. Account locked for 30 minutes. Handing over to travel desk."
Dispatch authorized zero-fare rebooking to carrier provider
Check corporate policy & agency spending limits (₹50k/₹100k)
"Additional fare exceeds automated corporate limit. Awaiting agency approval."
VCC armed & locked to approved amount, currency, and MCC 3000
Dispatch payment-authorized rebooking with VCC credentials
Step 8: Authoritatively verify reservation on airline host
Confirm electronic ticket (e-ticket) issuance and coupon validation
Capture settled payment with card issuer
Step 9: Dispatches Final WhatsApp Confirmation (PNR, Ticket, Baggage)
Verified e-ticket, itinerary link, and baggage guidance delivered
Void uncaptured VCC authorization / refund captured payment (PAYMENT_VOIDED)
Action Notice: Rebooking failed, escalated to travel desk specialist
Query carrier host using idempotency key (caseId)
Dispatches Final WhatsApp Confirmation (PNR, Ticket, Baggage)
Notice: Rebooking timed out and safely voided. Escalated to travel desk.
Notice: Transaction status ambiguous. Flagged for manual treasury audit.
